'''Robr Selvi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[High Justice]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Court of Justice]] as of [[44 ABY]]. When fellow [[Chief Justice|Grand Justice]] [[Tela Rovas]], who was an undercover [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]], received a letter from the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] asking for her surrender, Rovas used Selvi as a Human shield when the evacuation from the chambers occurred. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] decided not to activate a booby trapped sliding door from crushing the pair, as her orders explicitly forbade civilian casualties, despite Selvi's reputation for corruption.<ref name="apocalypse" />
